name: Orbital Descent
summary:
Dive into Orbital Descent, a fast-paced maze challenge where every tilt of the maze can lead you to victory or send you spiraling off track. You're in charge of guiding a rolling ball through twists, turns, and obstacles as the maze rotates beneath you.

You can discover hidden shortcuts and speedrun tech to cut your time or find all the coins to go for 100% completion. With simple controls, you can try to master the maze. Use checkpoints to reset to a safe point, but remove the timer, to practice the hardest parts of the level and master the maze.

So jump in, pick your path, and see if you have what it takes to conquer Orbital Descent.
